relations.title: From Complicated to Complex: The AI Safety Paradox
relations.reading: Component-level compliance does not establish ecosystem-level integrity when independently governed actors compose their decisions under changing conditions.

relations.title: Case Study: DMG MORI — Multilevel Post-Merger Integration, International Supply Chain Control & Mission-Critical Industrial Delivery (2013 – 2016)
relations.reading: Industrial delivery is complete only when the composed chain supports customer production readiness; passing each local control does not establish that end-to-end outcome.
